objective: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

description: Greetings, brother/sister. Duthorian Rall, one of our most influential paladins, was speaking about you recently. I overheard him talking about how it was time you be put to the test some... along with some very complimentary things about how well you've performed thus far.
If I were you, I'd head to Stormwind and speak to him when you have time. I'm sure he's in the Cathedral of Light--that's where he spends most of his time.
completion: It is beautiful here in Stormwind, is it not?
Your timing actually couldn't have been better, <name>.
